title: Mad-max esque Chase scene made in Roblox with Claude
author: SeaThePirate
selftext:
For context of how crazy this is is, Roblox as an engine does not typically play well with physics or cars that use real physics, and also when things are made up of pieces that can break up

Every vehicle you see here has actual suspension, has actual physics, and can also has modular destruction when taking enough damage

Additionally, everything you see here is unscripted, every single NPC and vehicle is their own entity which is interfacing with the other entities to create a 'movie' like scene, but its all actual entities that are taking damage, attacking, deciding where to move, etc.

* Made entirely with Claude High Effort and no existing assets or anything else
* Took about 1 day total to make everything, about \~10 hours of compute
